class.name: AudioDeviceSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [AudioDeviceSettingsServer]: the audio output and input device.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"audio_device"[/code]. [AudioDeviceSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]) and stores it in [code]user://settings/audio_device.ini[/code]. Change the values through [method AudioDeviceSettingsServer.set_output_device] or [method SettingsServer.set_value], not on the resource, so that they are validated and applied. It can also be used as the project defaults of the domain: save an [AudioDeviceSettings] as a [code].tres[/code] file and name it in the project setting [code]settings/defaults/audio_device[/code].

members.member: The name of the input device, as listed by [method AudioServer.get_input_device_list]. [code]"Default"[/code] is the default device of the system. An empty string is stored as [code]"Default"[/code].

The name of the output device, as listed by [method AudioServer.get_output_device_list]. [code]"Default"[/code] is the default device of the system. An empty string is stored as [code]"Default"[/code].
